Alex: Quick check — can we shift next week's weekly triage from Tue 11:00 -> Tue 10:30? Several people flagged 11 conflicts. Want to keep it timeboxed to 30m.
Maria: 10:30 works for me. Also +1 to a short 'urgent bug lane' slot (5m) so P0s don't eat the whole meeting.
Jamal: 10:30 OK. Prefer total meeting stays 20–30m. If we add urgent lane we should rotate ownership weekly.
Sophie: I'm on-call that Tue, 10:30 is better. Agenda proposal:
```
- 0–5m: quick backlog hits (async pre-read encouraged)
- 5–10m: urgent bug lane (owner triages P0s)
- 10–25m: owner updates + blockers
- 25–30m: decisions / next actions
```
Kevin: small ask — can we attach a 1-paragraph pre-read to the event each week? I'll maintain it in the triage folder.
Maria: I'll take week 1 urgent-lane ownership. @Jamal can you do week 2?
Jamal: Yep I can do week 2. Can we add a sticky note in the agenda with the owner tag so it's visible in the meeting invite? e.g., "Urgent lane owner: @Maria"
Alex: Sounds good. I'll update the calendar invite and add a short template in the invite notes. Also let's try the 5m urgent lane at first; if it overflows we'll bump to 10m and shorten owner updates.
calendar-bot: Event updated — "Weekly Eng Bug Rendezvous" moved: Tue 11:00 -> Tue 10:30. Invite updated for channel: eng.
Sophie: tiny follow-up — can we mark recurring agenda as "pre-read required" so people fill in backlog bullets 24h before? Helps keep meeting under 30m.
Alex: agreed. New process: pre-reads 24h, rotating urgent-lane owner, meeting at Tue 10:30, 30m boxed. I'll post the new invite + template in #eng and ping owners. :thumbsup:
Maria: :thumbsup:
Jamal: thanks, Alex.
Kevin: I'll drop the pre-read link in the invite now.
Alex: closing — if nobody objects I'll finalize by EOD and create the weekly checklist doc.
